title: Customer escalation: nine-minute wait at Atlanta Buckhead

messages.text: I waited nine minutes at the Atlanta Buckhead drive-thru for a Double Stack at lunch. Please call me back on (404) 555-0182 or write to jordan.miles@example.com.
Logged as a wait-time complaint. Apologised, offered the $5 voucher, and did not promise a fix date.
Atlanta Buckhead is our top store for wait-time tickets this week. Escalating it to Store Ops with the ticket numbers, not the customer details.
